Type: shelf
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Wood and Metal Bookcase, 14"W, Wood and Dark Metal
Colors: Elm
Materials: metal
A bi-level shelf adds architectural interest to this modern industrial bookcase. Tall and narrow, it's perfect against a wall or behind a sofa, and for holding books, photos and even electronics. Wood and metal give it modern industrial style. 14.2"W x 47.2"D x 31.5"H Fiberboard with elm and metal finish Wood and iron together create a modern industrial piece with hints of rustic Compact design for small spaces No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
